caption: Winter's coming, and so is blanket washing season! Bison Express Wash gets your horse blankets clean, waterproofed, and ready for the cold. Drop off or schedule a pickup today.
Dirty, muddy, or just due for a refresh? We handle horse blanket washing so you don't have to. Message us to book your spot before the winter rush.
A clean blanket means a happier, warmer horse. Ask us about our wash and repair service, we'll have it back to you looking (and smelling) brand new.
Reminder: the earlier you get your blankets in for washing, the better your spot for winter! Reach out to schedule yours.
